instagram.caption:
The box you have never opened.
The Bulk and Overhead Storage in the Garage. Holds the things you genuinely need once or twice a year, high up and out of the way, without becoming the place decisions go to hide.

What done looks like:
1. Every overhead bin labelled in letters you can read standing on the slab
2. A last-opened month
3. Year on the end of each one
4. The heaviest bins on the lowest rack
